r: bootc-install-ensure-completion - Intended for use in environments that are performing an ostree-based installation, not bootc

Intended for use in environments that are performing an ostree-based installation, not bootc.

In this scenario the installation may be missing bootc specific features such as kernel arguments, logically bound images and more. This command can be used to attempt to reconcile. At the current time, the only tested environment is Anaconda using `ostreecontainer` and it is recommended to avoid usage outside of that environment. Instead, ensure your code is using `bootc install to-filesystem` from the start.
